source_runtime_contract: Compose typed committed scheduled source selection with the explicit resolved irrigation executor in the adapter, using immutable parameters/request and one committed snapshot. Reuse selected-start reconstruction for trial and runtime calls. Preparation failure returns rejected diagnostics and unchanged committed provenance; successful preparation passes only ephemeral forcing/event to the existing runtime publication boundary. No callback escape hatch, second owner, global registry admission or backend dependency on adapter. Direct scheduled DCS2 is first; checked DCS1 profile runtime composition remains separate.
resolved_runtime_contract: Baseline 50227a856. Add an explicit restricted resolved-column irrigation entry to the existing serialized runtime. Immutable prepared forcing, single-node configuration and optional selected event pass to the existing checked backend entry. Reuse the same checkpoint, mass-completeness gate, per-column commit/discard and provenance collection as ordinary execution; do not duplicate publication authority. Ordinary entry, registry and bootstrap remain unchanged. Affects invariants 3, 5, 7, 13, 23 and 28. Required gates: pending/new mixed success and internally progressed failure in both execution orders, decoded restart, unchanged BASE/guards and O0/O2 identity. This is a resolved execution integration, not parser/bootstrap or canonical admission. Local checkpoints only as requested; no remote publication.
profile_selection_trial_contract: Compose checked committed DCS1 profile selection with the selected hydraulic trial through the same private prepared-source dispatch used by direct scheduled selection. Geometry remains supplied and validated; snapshot supplies event, sensor and water profile. Invalid geometry returns no kernel candidate. No second state owner, alternate selection equations, post-commit event rewrite or change to BASE admission.
selected_trial_contract: Extend explicit irrigation trials with an optional newly selected scheduled event. It must start at the exact outer boundary, preserve the inactive owner's next-event index, match the supplied single-node rate and pass full carrier validation. Keep it as call-local trial configuration; inject it only into trial state at the initial boundary, replaying it on rejected initial attempts. Never initialize a replacement committed owner. The source adapter may accept an optional typed selection request and derive this event from the existing scheduled process flux. Rejected hydraulic intervals retain the original inactive owner; accepted kernel commit publishes the selected event together with hydraulics/history. Default pending-only calls keep selection disabled.
pending_source_trial_contract: Compose committed pending-event source preparation with the explicit pending hydraulic trial in the adapter. Derive SSDI rate and source-stop marker from the existing owner; callers supply previous physical forcing and immutable scheduled parameters, not a manually synchronized irrigation rate. Selection opportunity remains false, so this entry point cannot create a new gift. Return only the existing kernel candidate and diagnostics; commit remains an explicit existing-owner operation. Preserve split/rejection behavior without actionable candidates.
pending_trial_contract: Implement an explicit restricted backend entry point for an already-selected scheduled gift, with a supplied immutable single SSDI node. Validate exact carrier/template/time, mode 7 temporal-certificate configuration, no combined optional physics, and prescribed source equality to the saved gift (or zero for inactive state). Reject windows crossing event end. Reuse the existing kernel trial/commit path and temporal history service; clear the event only in the trial state at its exact end, never in the committed owner. The ordinary backend entry point and runtime known-layout registry remain unchanged by default. This bounded pending-event trial path does not select new gifts or admit production-bootstrap scheduling. Qualification requires accepted continuation and rollback/restart tests before broader wiring.
committed_profile_source_contract: Extend the single-owner source entry point to DCS1 profile composition. Reuse one private snapshot validator for direct and profile variants. Profile geometry and crop tables remain caller-supplied immutable configuration; event, sensor state and profile water content come from the same committed snapshot. Invalid geometry must return no actionable forcing and leave the owner unchanged. This is tentative source preparation, not hydraulic execution or acceptance.
committed_source_adapter_contract: Next implementation: a read-only adapter obtains bound time and an exact irrigation carrier snapshot from kernel_committed_state_t, validates template/time/node identity, and derives both event and hydraulic view from that single snapshot before invoking the existing scheduled source composition. It returns tentative event/flux/forcing only, never publishes or changes the owner. An invalid owner exposes no actionable outputs; a valid snapshot with rejected request preserves its event candidate. This removes independently supplied event/hydraulic input from this entry point, but does not enable backend runtime execution or prove acceptance.
profile_binding_implementation: 3997e90bd adds evaluate_ppa_profile_irrigation_source, combining the existing checked root-zone/profile DCS1 composition with water-only SSDI binding. Candidate/flux/forcing are actionable only when both stages succeed; failure preserves base and leaves no allocated forcing. Geometry and crop/profile inputs remain supplied, not derived by a new owner. The actual DCS1 source-acceptance owner test now uses this single adapter call. c485ad836 adds invalid negative thickness and unsupported-solute binding rejection before each valid tile call. Scheduling, accepted publication and pending-event restart remain unimplemented.
source_binding_implementation: 3d16532f7 introduces src/adapter/mod_ppa_irrigation_source_binding.f90. It consumes previous physical forcing and successful SSDI process flux, copies unrelated forcing fields, replaces the SSDI rates and marks only a changed source or an existing event at the exact interval start. Expired marks are consumed; future/nonfinite marked times, invalid/split diagnostics, absent/mismatched/nonfinite/negative sources and contradictory inactive delivery are rejected without output. This helper binds water source rates only; it does not map solute, persist events, prove acceptance, or infer changes in other forcing fields. Caller supplies otherwise unchanged forcing and must manage other physical changes explicitly. The owner integration test uses this binding for source start/continuation/stop instead of hand-setting event flags.
